scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute normalized key/query dot-product weights and weighted value output.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: dot_i=sum_j Kij*qj;score_i=exp(dot_i)/sum exp(dot);out_j=sum_i score_i*Vij; no sqrt(d) scaling.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 1024 key/value rows x64 features, one query.
invariants: Weights positive and approximately sum to1 in finite fixture.
Output is weighted value combination; no positional/masking stages.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: GlobalFloat32atomic normalization order and exp lowering; no max-subtracted stable softmax in nativeimpl0.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Attention tensor primitive supporting sequence models; no end-to-end model or domain-science application inferred.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Single-query unscaled naive attention and bounded fixture, not general multihead masked attention.
